snippet.title: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4382260/
Experience a bright, upbeat anime-style survival game like never before!  "Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles" 🏝️ is coming soon to PC(Steam) in 2026! 
Enjoy diverse life content, thrilling dungeon adventures, custom dream house decorating, gorgeous costumes, and multiplayer with friends—all in one place! Start your own special island life with charming girls right now!
